QUOTE: "`HealthMonitor` worker threads only enqueue events. `process_events()` (called from `server_manager.cpp:710`) drains them and runs the callbacks on the engine thread." Also the table: "`watched_` and `event_queue_` each have a mutex".
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the monitor thread only enqueues events (with a mutex-guarded event_queue_) and that process_events() drains them and runs callbacks on the engine (caller) thread.
